value.text: Got the link for Preschool Sports and Games, Wednesdays at 10:30 AM, through Springfield's portal. It's listed for ages 3 to 5, so it fits Maya. The price is $280.60, or $290.60 if you're not a resident. Course code is 00028147. Residents can sign up starting Sep 8, and the public date is Tuesday, September 15 at 10:30 a.m. The page also lists a registration form I can't see, so leave some time for that. Heads up: I had Monday, September 14 at 10:30 a.m. saved before, but the page says the 15th, so I'm going by the page.
